name: Orbit R
idea: An R with a moon on an orbit that passes behind and in front of the letter. Space-themed, but not tied to one game.

name: Mod block
idea: A building block with one piece lifted out and hovering above it. Fits any game with parts, blocks or items.

name: Placed pixel
idea: A pixel-built R with its last pixel still moving into place. The clearest of the five at 16 px.

name: Lab flask
idea: A lab flask with a ringed planet inside it, for the 'labs' in the name.

name: Selection reticle
idea: Game-UI selection brackets around an RL monogram, with a short burn streak. Reads as games in any genre.
